coverage_assessment: 20 Spanish/English web queries across all February weeks and selected national/regional/sector leads; 586 captured headers, 87 source cards, 5 original bodies opened and one actual HTTP403. Nine provisional candidates include four body-reviewed threshold-pending actions and five search-only leads. Open-web, language, archive and date-filter limits prevent any exhaustiveness claim. Contemporaneous publisher/denial and exact-URL guards did not preserve comprehensive cross-publisher written-origin comparisons; source-level notes record the limitation and observed related leads without inferring copying or independence.
